games_wide: Holds game-level and play/inning-level records for MLB games; grain = one row per game-play/inning event (columns like gameId, seasonId, inningNumber, inningHalf, inningEventType, inningHalfEventSequenceNumber, atBatEventSequenceNumber); keys/measures include gameId, seasonId, startTime, gameStatus, attendance, dayNight, duration/durationMinutes, awayTeamId/awayTeamName, homeTeamId/homeTeamName, venueId/venueName/venueCity/venueState/venueCapacity/venueSurface, homeFinalRuns/homeFinalHits/homeFinalErrors, awayFinalRuns/awayFinalHits/awayFinalErrors, homeFinalRunsForInning, awayFinalRunsForInning, description, createdAt, updatedAt.
schedules: Contains scheduled game entries; grain = one row per scheduled game (columns like gameId, gameNumber); keys/measures include gameId, gameNumber, seasonId, year, type, dayNight, duration/duration_minutes, homeTeamId/homeTeamName, awayTeamId/awayTeamName, startTime, attendance, status, created.
games_post_wide: Contains post-game and play/inning-level records for MLB games (similar to games_wide but likely filtered/updated after completion); grain = one row per game-play/inning event (columns like gameId, seasonId, inningNumber, inningHalf, inningEventType, inningHalfEventSequenceNumber, atBatEventSequenceNumber); keys/measures include gameId, seasonId, startTime, gameStatus, attendance, dayNight, duration/durationMinutes, awayTeamId/awayTeamName, homeTeamId/homeTeamName, venueId/venueName/venueCity/venueState/venueCapacity/venueSurface, homeFinalRuns/homeFinalHits/homeFinalErrors, awayFinalRuns/awayFinalHits/awayFinalErrors, homeFinalRunsForInning, awayFinalRunsForInning, description, createdAt, updatedAt.
